actual_comparison.literal_meaning: Little sleep, so much happening; fate has made me pine away.
actual_comparison.explanation: A weary complaint that troubles leave little rest. The exaggerated lament carries the feeling of being overwhelmed.
actual_comparison.meaning_odia: ବିଶ୍ରାମ ପାଇଁ ସମୟ ଅଳ୍ପ, ଅଥଚ ଚିନ୍ତା ଓ ଘଟଣାର ଶେଷ ନାହିଁ। ଏହି କ୍ଲାନ୍ତିକୁ ବକ୍ତା ଭାଗ୍ୟର ଦୋଷ ଦେଇ ବଡ଼ ଅଭିଯୋଗରେ କହୁଛନ୍ତି। ଅତିଶୟୋକ୍ତିଟି ମନର ଭାରକୁ ବୁଝାଏ, ଜୀବନ ସବୁବେଳେ ଏପରି ରହିବ ବୋଲି ଭବିଷ୍ୟବାଣୀ ନୁହେଁ।
actual_comparison.usage_example: After several demanding days, someone sighs that even bedtime brings another worry. (New editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
